name: Arc Converter - Automatic Item Processing
shortDesc: Auto-disassemble new weapons, craft ammunition, and convert junk into eddies

enabled.label: Enable Arc Converter
enabled.description: Master switch for automatic item processing.

disassemble.label: Weapons
disassemble.description: Process only newly acquired weapons. Existing weapons remain untouched.

tier1.label: Tier 1 (+ variants)
tier1.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 1 weapons.

tier2.label: Tier 2 (+ variants)
tier2.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 2 weapons.

tier3.label: Tier 3 (+ variants)
tier3.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 3 weapons.

tier4.label: Tier 4 (+ variants)
tier4.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 4 weapons.

tier5.label: Tier 5 (+ variants)
tier5.description: Disassemble eligible newly acquired Tier 5 weapons.

ammo.label: Automatically craft ammunition
ammo.description: Craft vanilla ammo for the equipped weapon using real components.

threshold.label: Craft when reserve below (%)
threshold.description: Trigger crafting when equipped weapon's ammunition is below this percentage of capacity.

sell_junk.label: Automatically sell junk for eddies
sell_junk.description: Automatically convert ordinary junk and jewelry into eddies at the game's selling prices, including items already in V's backpack. Quest and protected items are skipped.

weapon_action.label: Weapon action
weapon_action.description: Sell eligible new weapons for eddies or disassemble them into components.

clothes_enabled.label: Clothes
clothes_enabled.description: Process only newly acquired clothing. Existing clothes remain untouched.

clothes_action.label: Clothes action
clothes_action.description: Sell eligible new clothes for eddies or disassemble them into components.
